value.rationale: The phase diagram answers an operationally meaningful tolerance-scheduling question with a sharp inequality \(a+b\le1\), strictly more informative than simply forcing both inner solves below one-half. The restart-rescue wedge \(a+b>1\) and \(a^2+b^2<1\) distinguishes two provable worst-case algorithmic behaviors, and the exact cycle factor provides a quantitative design rule. This classification is neither a mere renaming nor a finite unmotivated exercise.
